title: carthamus glaucus subsp. alexandrinus
intro: Carthamus glaucus subsp. alexandrinus, commonly known as Safflower or False Safflower, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and lower cholesterol levels, as well as its potential anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Carthamus glaucus subsp. alexandrinus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are mediated by its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, carotenoids, and fatty acids. The plant's bioactive constituents, including kaempferol, quercetin, and luteolin, contribute to its therapeutic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
